usage: A neutral, common noun for a song or musical piece. It sounds natural in both everyday conversation and media contexts.
It can refer to a single song, or to a piece of music more generally, depending on context.
Often used with classifiers like 一首歌曲 when counting individual songs.
More formal or written than the everyday word 歌; for casual speech, people often just say 歌.
